claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_reroll
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Luck fires only when a natural 1 is rolled on a D20 Test and allows a single reroll that must be kept. This is mechanically distinct from advantage (which rolls 2d20 and takes the higher before the roll resolves) and from modify_roll_numeric (an additive bonus). The trigger is a specific die-face result, not a blanket before-roll enhancement. The v4 taxonomy lists modify_roll_reroll as an effect atom but it is absent from types.ts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.
